comparison.objective: Move a slung crate over a coaming by coordinating two cargo falls, versus tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tension coordination, load trajectory control, and easing/hauling ropes versus small-tool alignment, rotary tuning, locking torque, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Crate landed on the green pad while hands avoid the load/hatch versus two safe repeatable carriage stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Dynamic suspended-load control is meaningfully different from commissioning an energy absorber. No specs provide numeric load/contact tolerances.
